sloka: अथ यास्यति वैदेही वनम् रामेण सम्गता ।वयमप्यनुयास्यामः पुरम् चेदम् गमिष्यति ॥२-३७-२५॥
transliteration: atha yāsyati vaidehī vanam rāmeṇa samgatā ।vayamapyanuyāsyāmaḥ puram cedam gamiṣyati ॥2-37-25॥

translations.english: Otherwise, if Sita goes with Rama to the forest, all of us along with the entire city will follow.
